newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: 28 hurt as S.African police disperse drug protest.
newsitem.headline: 28 hurt as S.African police disperse drug protest.

text.p: Twenty-eight people were hurt when South African police used rubber bullets and birdshot to disperse a violent demonstration against drug dealers, a spokeswoman said on Sunday.

Police fired after some in the crowd threw stones during a Saturday protest against a lack of action against known drug dealers in Clanwilliam, about 200 km (125 miles) northeast of Cape Town, Superintendent Ciska du Plessis said.

Vigilantes threatening to kill drug dealers have repeatedly confronted police during marches in South Africa. In August militant Moslems publicly shot and burned to death an alleged drug merchant and gang leader near Cape Town.
